newsitem.title: USA: U.S. economy can grow faster, Fed's Lindsey says.
newsitem.headline: U.S. economy can grow faster, Fed's Lindsey says.

text.p: Federal Reserve Governor Lawrence Lindsey said on Thursday that the U.S. economy can grow faster than it has.
But he told the Investment Program Association that the way to achieve that was not through loose monetary policy.
Instead, he suggested that government make more efficient use of its resources and called for reforms of basic education and the Social Security pension system.
"There really is no trade-off in any sustained fashion between inflation and unemployment, or inflation and economic growth," Lindsey said.
"The best thing we (the Fed) can do for economic growth is above all do no harm, create an environment in which long-term planning can take place," he added. "That means low inflation rates."
